The thread and the markers are copied, never edited.

🧺 groom-proposal: ab09ece4ddee

# Groom proposal `ab09ece4ddee` — cycle 15

17 cards of 69 in Intake are proposed for cycle 15, in the order below. Of those, 14 for Planning and 3 for Cancel. Nothing moves until you approve it.

Ranked by claude-fable-5-1 (asked) / claude-fable-5-1 (answered) in 1 call over 69 cards, against 20 of 35 epics in flight (title and plan summary), the newest 40 of 2,788 merged PRs (titles only) and the newest 60 of 3,384 closed cards (titles and reason lines) — 61 of 69 cards ranked (1 the model declined). The answer came back in 2 pieces and was joined before it was read.

**To approve:** comment `🧺 groom-approved: ab09ece4ddee` on this card. Approval moves the Planning list to Planning and the Cancel list to Canceled. Anything else — including a comment that mentions the marker — leaves both lists where they are.

**To say more than yes:** `🧺 groom-declined: ab09ece4ddee — <reason>` declines the batch (the reason is required); `🧺 groom-excluded: ab09ece4ddee DRE-N` keeps a card on either list in Intake and out of every later proposal (don't do); `🧺 groom-held: ab09ece4ddee DRE-N` keeps it in Intake and ranks it last next time (hold); `🧺 groom-added: ab09ece4ddee DRE-N` pulls one in, after the batch; `🧺 groom-rewrite-accepted: ab09ece4ddee DRE-N` accepts the draft posted on card DRE-N and sends it to Planning with the new body.
